Subject: Re: Escalation: Dedicated pool saturation — SparkFin (DEAL-9342)

Quick update from Eng:

Findings:
- The pool reached 92-96% GPU utilization during 08:15-09:45 PDT. KV cache hit drops and queuing caused token latency growth.
- One node showed elevated PCIe errors (transient), causing request backpressure on neighboring nodes while rebalancing.

Immediate mitigations we applied (10:20 PDT):
1) Provisioned +2 reserved-capacity nodes to the pool (expected to be online in ~14 minutes).
2) Enabled routing fallback to model quantized-v2 for non-critical routes to reduce per-token compute.
3) Short-term rate-limit bump for SparkFin's payment route to reduce queueing; monitoring impact.

Attachments:
- pool_utilization_20261012.png
- pci_errors_10-12.log

Longer term:
- We'll run a placement sweep and pin a dedicated anti-affinity policy for DEAL-9342 to avoid future noisy neighbor issues.
- Ops will follow up with an RCA once nodes stabilize.

Vivek
